t3 complete: Core/Value.lean fully machine-checked (lake build green, no sorry). All 11 Value ctors; list-based VSet; assoc-list ValueMap (doc §9.3, no HashMap); valEq refl/symm/trans proven via WF-measure drivers; §6.1 setEq law + Decidable instance; filterMeta/isMetaKey ported (drops #*, action_taken, parameters). Key design notes for dependents: (1) valEq is a def, NOT a BEq/LawfulBEq instance (set extensionality {1,1}={1} breaks eq_of_beq) — use `valEq a b = true` or theorem valEq_refl/symm/trans; (2) mapCont_iff: map equality = same-key entry containment; (3) valueSize counts +1 per list/map element so all WF measures decrease — reuse if Codec needs sizes. Codec/Shell can now `import Core`.

All §6.2 theorems proven: lossless repartition (resplit_lookup_union, conditional on ResplitKeyInv — the parse-time key invariant mirroring the Haskell FromJSON split; note the Haskell resplit itself drops keys in neither pvs nor vars, we match that behavior and prove losslessness under the invariant), exactly-one-side + unconditional disjointness, traceSteps length/order/nth with idx=j and injected action_taken = action name. API notes for dependents (Diff/Protocol/Codec): maps are ValueMap (assoc list); ValueMap.union (left-biased append), ValueMap.filterKeys + lookup_filterKeys lemma added; actionTakenKey := "action_taken"; Step has idx/act/params/vars fields. Faithfulness audit of t9 vs your directive done; Core/Protocol.lean updated and green (lean exit 0, lake build Core ✔, 1464 lines). Verified against the spec text directly (I re-read the MirrorRecv*/MirrorSend* region at the pin): (1) flow is state — TlaState carries flow, Session carries Flow ✓; recv* flow assignments match the spec exactly (register/explore/genTraces→traces, exploreSession→session, validate→validate). (2) MirrorRecvRegisterTraces fast path idle→ready+SPEC_VALIDATED is its own TlaStep ctor (no validating); Core.step folds it with MirrorSendInitialState and step_refines_tla decomposes into exactly those spec actions ✓. (3) MirrorSendSpecValidatedValid branch-on-flow encoded as two ctors (traces→ready, validate→done) ✓. (4) recvReportOk queues STEP_OK only; NEXT_STEP via separate sendNextStep ctor — Core.step's [stepOk, nextStep] refines to recvReportOk ++ [sendNextStep] (queue-empty side conditions are client-interaction obligations, documented at the ctor) ✓. (5) Ok/AllDone/Mismatch are three distinct ctors ✓. (6) ADDED: specPhases/Ms, tlaStep_preserves_phaseOk + tlaSteps_phaseOk + step_phaseOk (PhaseOk), and ClientNeverStuck mirror obligations: emit_step_responses_from_stepping, emit_initialState_target_stepping (p=idle ∧ p'=stepping), emit_explorerReady_target_exploring. (7) ext* async-job steps clearly separated with doc comments ✓. Two deliberate abstractions, both documented in-module (no Core.step behavior unmappable, so no STOP needed): (a) added TlaStep ctor sendSpecValidatedInvalid so the relation covers the spec's validate-only invalid outcome, but Core.step's oracle uses sendRegisterError for the failing validate branch — the spec equally allows RegisterError for REGISTER_VALIDATE; (b) valid/invalid collapse at tag level (spec itself abstracts the SpecInvalid payload). Pin ModelMirros@3496251 recorded in the module doc.
